architecture-author.description: Maintain Landing's high-level architecture canvas, component contracts, and invariants.
architecture-author.prompt: Use this skill when work changes or clarifies a major component, cross-component contract, durable invariant, or architectural boundary.

commit-your-changes.description: Audit the shared working tree and safely commit only changes made in the current conversation.
commit-your-changes.prompt: Use this skill to commit only the files you changed without disturbing concurrent work.

council.description: Convene isolated expert personas to stress-test a decision and synthesize their evidence and disagreements.
council.prompt: Use this skill to convene named specialist personas around a consequential question or review.

council-runner.description: Run Landing's council protocol for a parent agent and return only the final synthesis.
council-runner.prompt: Use this skill when another orchestrator needs a council decision without orchestration narration.

deep-reviewer.description: Run an evidence-backed multi-lane review over an exact change set, with lanes selected from the actual diff.
deep-reviewer.prompt: Use this skill for an end-of-phase review across the specialist seams touched by a diff.

director.description: Direct a slate of work through isolated engineering managers and visible evidence gates.
director.prompt: Use this skill to sequence and supervise several engineering workstreams through completion.

domain-engineer.description: Review whether Landing code expresses domain intent, ownership, and justified abstraction.
domain-engineer.prompt: Use this skill for naming, module ownership, procedure-versus-thing, and duplication or extraction judgments.

engineering-manager.description: Orchestrate Landing specialists, grade their evidence, resolve disagreements, and drive authorized work to a verified close.
engineering-manager.prompt: Use this skill to run a piece of engineering work through specialist implementation and review.

founding-engineer.description: Provide pragmatic founding-engineer judgment on architecture, sequencing, debt, and product leverage.
founding-engineer.prompt: Use this skill for consequential technical strategy, architecture, build-versus-buy, and sequencing decisions.

frontend-engineer.description: Provide corpus-grounded frontend architecture, React mental-model, component, and state-ownership guidance.
frontend-engineer.prompt: Use this skill for frontend component, state, data-flow, effect, and architecture decisions.

go-engineer.description: Provide corpus-grounded Go guidance on concurrency lifecycles, error modeling, package and interface design, and testability.
go-engineer.prompt: Use this skill for Go implementation and review: goroutine lifecycles, context and cancellation, error taxonomy and wrapping, package and interface boundaries, and testable structure.

pattern-author.description: Create and maintain Landing's durable, repeatable engineering patterns.
pattern-author.prompt: Use this skill when a repeated engineering rule may deserve a canonical pattern document.

persona.description: Research and create a canonical Landing persona command, optional corpus, metadata, and dispatch registrations.
persona.prompt: Use this skill to create or extend a source-grounded persona command and its generated agent surfaces.

product.description: Provide candid product-owner judgment on user value, product-market fit, focus, and sequencing.
product.prompt: Use this skill for product strategy, product-owner feedback, scope, value, and sequencing decisions.

product-author.description: Write or update Landing product documentation as the canonical desired user experience.
product-author.prompt: Use this skill when work changes or clarifies Landing's user value, experience, behavior, boundaries, messaging, onboarding, routing policy, or user stories.

security-engineer.description: Provide threat-model-driven application security review for Landing's credentials, subprocess, configuration, and agent boundaries.
security-engineer.prompt: Use this skill for threat modeling, security review, secrets, trust boundaries, and supply-chain risk.

sync.description: Synchronize canonical Landing commands into generated Claude agents and Codex skills.
sync.prompt: Use this skill after changing canonical command instructions or skill metadata.

systems-engineer.description: Review Landing's end-to-end dataflow, capacity, failure modes, timeouts, retries, cancellation, and operability.
systems-engineer.prompt: Use this skill for systems dataflow, scaling, bottleneck, backpressure, and reliability decisions.

testing-engineer.description: Provide corpus-grounded test design and implement tests that protect meaningful Landing behavior contracts.
testing-engineer.prompt: Use this skill to decide what is worth testing and design deterministic behavior-focused tests.

thank-you.description: Close the current work with an accurate concise handoff and no new actions.
thank-you.prompt: Use this skill to end a completed task with outcome, verification, status, and remaining follow-ups.

tldr.description: Produce a human-level architectural walkthrough of the solution currently being designed.
tldr.prompt: Use this skill to explain the current proposed solution end to end without changing it.

typescript-engineer.description: Provide corpus-grounded TypeScript soundness, modeling, boundary, strictness, and scale guidance.
typescript-engineer.prompt: Use this skill for TypeScript design, review, compiler posture, runtime boundaries, and migration decisions.

ui-engineer.description: Provide consumer-grade UI judgment on composition, hierarchy, restraint, accessibility, imagery, and motion.
ui-engineer.prompt: Use this skill for polished UI composition, visual hierarchy, interaction, and motion decisions.

watchdog.description: Monitor a long-running job on a recurring interval until it reaches a verified terminal state.
watchdog.prompt: Use this skill to monitor an active build, check, script, or other long-running job.
